caseName: Bricker v. Sceva Speare Memorial Hospital
caseNameFull: Bricker v. Sceva Speare Memorial Hospital

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. N. H. Motion of American College of Legal Medicine for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted and case set for oral argument.
